captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a cinema prime lens with a matte-black housing and a wide, conical front shade. The main barrel features a thick knurled focus ring and a narrower iris ring, both detailed with white indicator ticks. At the rear, a metallic grey mount ring is equipped with a small, adjustable locking lever. The focus and iris rings are designed as separate, rotatable bands around the central optical barrel.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cinema prime lens with a matte-black housing, featuring a wide conical front shade, a knurled focus ring, a narrower iris ring with white tick marks, and a metallic rear mount ring with a locking lever. captions.factory: The model is built by defining a system of concentric cylindrical and conical primitives. The main body is constructed using multiple stacked cylinders and a hollowed cone for the front shade. The focus and iris rings are created as separate cylindrical shells with small rectangular cutouts or contrasting white boxes representing the engraved tick marks. The rear mount ring is modeled as a short, light-grey cylinder, decorated with a small box and cylinder assembly representing the locking lever, all structured into an articulated assembly using revolute joints for the rotating rings.
